rows.criterion: A provider-neutral capacity observation (available, constrained until a time, exhausted until a time, unknown with reason) is read by the planner through a port; the planner never calls pacing providers directly.

evidence.reference: planning capacity: an exhausted provider orders provider-free work first and explains why; pacing state maps onto capacity

rows.criterion: Capacity uncertainty (unknown) is distinct from zero capacity in the plan output.

evidence.reference: planning capacity: no observed capacity is unknown, not zero, and changes nothing; unknown capacity is reported separately and never treated as exhausted

rows.criterion: Plan output explains whether capacity affected ordering (a per-item capacity note and a plan-level summary).

evidence.reference: planning capacity: the analysis document reports capacity and that provider switching is never chosen; a constrained provider affects every strategy's order

rows.criterion: The planner never proposes switching provider or model; it reports only whether the current provider's capacity constrains the item, and compatibility is out of its authority.

evidence.reference: planning capacity: an exhausted provider ... reasons say the planner does not choose providers

rows.criterion: Capacity input is optional and read-only: absent capacity leaves plans unchanged. Tests cover all states.

evidence.reference: planning capacity: no observed capacity is unknown, not zero, and changes nothing; capacity is part of the snapshot evidence only when observed
